title: Two more seeds and the 256^2 predator-free twin for 20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim: predators divide on 5/5 seeds at 128^2 (generation 2-3), prey reach generation >= 2 on 4/5 (seed 3: generation 1, 12 persistent splits); at 256^2 the twin is a frozen emulsion of 295 prey with 1 division after t=2000 against 30 with predators
summary: The claim's world.py, unchanged, labkit --lineage-k 5. 128^2 seeds 3 and 4 (t=12000): prey persistent splits 12 and 4 (max generation 1 and 2; 11 and 6 divisions after t=2000 by the claim's splits2.py), predators 35 and 35 (generation 2 and 3, merge/split 0.33 and 0.26); both kinds present at the end (prey 13 and 10, predators 21 and 21). With the claim's seeds 0-2 this makes prey generation 2, 6, 2, 1, 2 and predator generation 2, 2, 2, 2, 3 over 5 seeds. 256^2 predator-free twin (pred_on 0, seed 3, t=10000, same as the claim's pack256): 295 static prey droplets, 24 persistent splits all in the formation phase (generation 1), 1 division after t=2000 against 30 in the claim's 256^2 run with predators (prey generation 3 there).

finding.operator: seed and twin extension of the claim
finding.result: prey gen 1/2, predator gen 2/3 (seeds 3/4); twin 256^2: 295 prey, gen 1, 1 late division vs 30 with predators
